paite: Huan Elah tapa Israel kumpipa Hoshea, kum thum alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Ahaz tapa Hezekiah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah / (2 Kro 29.1,2; 31.1)
english: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Abi, Zakariah tanu ahi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.

paite: Apu David thilhih tengteng hih sam in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

paite: Mun sangte ahihgawp a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherahte aphuk a; Mosi dal gul bawl akitam nensak vek a; huai hun tanpha a Israel suante'n akiang a gimlim ahal ziak un, ama'n huai Nehushtan asa hi.
english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian amuang a; huchi in anung a Judah kumpipa tengteng lak ah amah bang kuamah a-om kei ua, amalam in leng a-om sam kei uh.
english: He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.

paite: TOUPA alen tinten a, ama zuih atawp nuam kei a, athupiak, TOUPA'N Mosi apiakte azui hi.
english: For he joined with Yahweh. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA akiang ah a-om a; avakkhiakna peuh ah alamzang a; Assuria kumpipa tung ah ahel a, a-nna asemta kei hi.
english: Yahweh was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.

paite: Philistiate Gaza khua tan in agamgi chiang tengteng toh, galvilmi insang a pan kulh nei khopi tan in azou vek hi.
english: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah kum li alal kum, Israel kumpipa Elah tapa Hoshea kum sagih alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in Samaria ahong dou a, a-umkimvel a,
english: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.

paite: huchi in kum thum achin kum in alazou hi. Hezekiah kum guk alal kum, Israel kumpipa Hoshea kum kua alal kum in ahi Samaria khua alak zoh.
english: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Assuria gam ah Israel apimang a, Halah, Habor, Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoihta hi;
english: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh thu mang lou a, athukhun bohsia a, TOUPA'N asikha Mosi thu apiak tengteng azuih louh ziak un.
english: because they didn’t obey Yahweh their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded, and would not hear it or do it.

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah kum sawm-le-li alal kum in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib Judah gam a khokulh nei tengteng dou ding in ahohtou a, alata hi.
heading: Assuriate'n Jerusalem Vaulau Uh / (2 Kro 32.1-19; Isa 36.1-22)
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in Lakish a Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhial hi, kei a pan kik nawn in, ka tung a na hon got peuhmah ka po ding," chi a gen ding in mi asawl hi. Assuria kumpipa'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dangka talent zathum leh dangka-eng talent sawmthum abikhiahsak hi.
english: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Withdraw from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn a dangka om teng leh kongkhak a dangka-eng tengteng leh kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a om tengteng apia hi.
english: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house.

paite: Huai tung mah in Hezekiah in TOUPA tempul kongkhak a dangka-eng aluante leh Judah kumpipa Hezekiah inn khuampite a kiluante alakhe vek a, Assuria kumpipa apia hi.
english: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of Yahweh’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Tartan, Rab-saris leh Rabshakeh sepaih tampi toh Lakish a pan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah asawl hi. Jerusalem khua atungtou ua; atuntouh un Puansawpmi Lamlian lampi a dil saknungzaw tuilakna kiang ah adingh uhi.
english: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

paite: Kumpipa asap uleh, insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah, akiang uah ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.

paite: Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah va gen dih ua, Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na gin a na muan bang ahia oi?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

paite: Kidouna a ding in geldan siam leh hatna ka nei uh, na chi a; himahleh huai zaw paukam lel ahi. Kua ahia na muan a ka tung a na hel maizen?
english: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

paite: Tu in, ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun, Aigupta muang na hita a; huai a mi akingaihleh akhut asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh bel amah muang tengteng tung ah huchibang ahi naknak hi.
english: Now, behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt. If a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him.

paite: Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, TOUPA ka Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh, na chih uleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judah leh Jerusalem kiang a Jerusalem a hiai maitam ma ah na biak ding uh ahi, chi a mun sangte leh amaitamte alakmangsakpa ahi kei a hia? chi in.
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?

paite: Huchi in ka pu Assuria kumpipa toh thu kichiam dih ua, huchi in atung a tuangmi ding na muh theih peuhmah ding leh sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding.
english: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

paite: Bangchi in ahia kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu in Aigupta tung a na muanna koih in, ka pu mite lak a neupen heutu khat lel leng na nankik zoh mahmah ding?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

paite: Hiai gam TOUPA lou a hihse ding a hong kuantou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, hiai gam dou inla, hihsia in, chi ahi,” chi in achi hi.
english: Have I now come up without Yahweh against this place to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’”’”

paite: Hilkiah tapa Eliakim leh Sebnah leh Joahte'n Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai lah ka theisiam ngal ua; kulh tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uh.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it. Don’t speak with us in the Jews’ language, in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

paite: Himahleh Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Ka pu in na pu uh kiang leh nou kiang kia ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulh tung a tute, noute leh a-ek uh ne dingte kiang ah leng hon sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

paite: Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa thu ngaikhia un.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om kei un; ama'n akhut a pan noute hon humbit thei lou ding ahi.
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N ahon humbit dia; hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in TOUPA ah hon muangsak kei hen.'
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

paite: Hezekiah thu pom kei un. Assuria kumpipa'n hichi in achi: Hon kileppih unla, ka kiang ah hong pawtkhia un; michih in ama grepgui leh ama theipi kung ngei ate ne chiat uhenla, michih in amah tuikhuk tui dawn chiat hen.
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

paite: Noumau gam bang a buh leh uain gam, tanghou leh grephuan gam, olive leh khuaizu gam, si lou a na hintheihna ding uh gam a ka hon pi masiah, Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a nou ahon khem in leng pom kei un.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.”

paite: Namte' pathian mawngmawng lak a himhim in agam uh Assuria kumpipa a pan ahumbit ngeita uh hia?
english: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

paite: Hamath leh Arpad pathiante koi a omta uh ahia? Sepharvaim, Hena leh Ivah pathiante leng koi a omta ahi ua? Samaria ka khut a pan ahumbit uhia?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

paite: Gam chih pathian tengteng lak a kuate ahi ua ka khut a pan agam uh humbit a, TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a pan humbit mahmah ding? chi in,” achi hi.
english: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

paite: Amau adai sipsip ua, kam khat in leng adawng kei uh, kumpipa dan thupiak, "Amah dawng ke'n," chih ahi ngal a.
english: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n apuansilh bohkekte uh silh in Hezekiah kiang ah ahoh ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.
